meta.name: ecommerce-video-marketing
meta.description: 电商运营与内容创作者必备！当您需要为多品类商品策划抖音、小红书等平台的带货视频时，一键生成包含痛点切入、产品展示与专业镜头设计的6阶段高质量视频脚本，轻松打造高转化营销内容，大幅提升品牌销量。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把商品卖点生成带镜头设计的带货视频脚本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为多品类商品快速产出高转化带货视频脚本
copy.tagline_en: Turn product selling points into video scripts with shot design
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly produce high-converting product video scripts

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按 6 阶段流程帮你写电商带货视频脚本：先收集商品信息、目标人群、视频风格、时长与平台，再产出「痛点切入→产品展示→痛点解决」结构的脚本，附镜头类型、运镜和字幕音乐建议。
howto.when: 当你需要为商品写带货视频脚本，或想要电商视频营销指导时触发。适用于抖音、小红书等平台。

say.text: 帮我给这款自动喂食器写一条30秒的带货视频脚本，目标人群是忙碌的都市白领
say.note: 它会先问人群、风格和平台

say.text: 我要做一条60秒科技感的智能厨电视频，帮我设计分镜和运镜
say.note: 按痛点切入→产品展示→痛点解决给结构

say.text: 这条护肤品脚本再帮我补上镜头类型和后期字幕、音乐建议
say.note: 输出特写、推拉等镜头与后期建议

howto.what_en: Claude runs a 6-stage flow to write ecommerce video scripts: it gathers product info, audience, style, length and platform, then outputs a script built on pain point, product demo and resolution, with shot and camera-move notes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to write a product video script or want ecommerce video marketing guidance. Fits platforms like Douyin and Xiaohongshu.

say_en.text: Write a 30s sales script for this pet feeder, aimed at busy city workers
say_en.note: It asks for audience, style and platform first

say_en.text: Draft a 60s tech-style smart kitchen video with shot and camera-move design
say_en.note: Structure follows pain point, demo, resolution

say_en.text: Add shot types plus subtitle and music notes to this skincare script
say_en.note: Returns close-up and dolly shots plus post tips
